verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an email client, so multi-account, multi-provider support is a fair question for it. The pack has no first-party claim of Microsoft 365, IMAP or multi-account support. Community material says the founder describes the integration as Gmail-API-only (not IMAP), users report it 'only works with Gmail', and one user asks when multi-account support would land; this evidence is dated, which limits confidence.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can connect several accounts across providers — Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP — and work them from one place
